title: SectionReviewResult
description: Accuracy and content-quality review result for one generated section

review_status.description: Yes for a high-confidence defect, Somewhat for a medium-confidence defect, otherwise No

claim_checks.description: Exactly one compact check for every supplied claim ID

claim_id.description: Claim ID copied from REQUIRED CLAIM AUDIT

result.description: PASS when no defect was found; FLAGGED when one or more findings refer to this claim

source_ids.description: Supporting or conflicting IDs copied from declared or ground sources; empty only when no source applies

audit_basis.description: Concise independent comparison of the generated binding with source context; for numeric claims include generated and source value/unit/boundary

findings.description: Factual or content-quality defects found in the section

sentence.description: Exact title, body sentence, or augmentation row/item from the generated section

source_evidence.description: Source evidence for the mismatch, or the prompt-defined fallback text

corrected_statement.description: Complete source-grounded replacement, or DELETE when none exists
